obligations.summary: Member States may be required to pay fees for advice and support provided by scientific panel experts, with fee structures set out in the implementing act referred to in Article 68(1).
exceptions: Fee structure must take into account cost-effectiveness and necessity of ensuring effective access to experts for all Member States.

obligations.summary: The Commission must facilitate timely access to scientific panel experts for Member States and ensure efficient organisation of combined support activities carried out by Union AI testing support and experts.
